title: Data Architecture
subtitle: From data engineering fundamentals to Iceberg lakehouses, Snowflake and semantic models
description: Modelling, data layers, storage, ingestion (batch, CDC, micro-batching, real time), orchestration, open-source frameworks, Apache Iceberg, Snowflake and semantic models, then ten reference architectures and three end-to-end case studies. Reading trail with checkpoint quizzes.
